title: Specify lead reconciliation envelope
description: Validates the request and response envelopes of the agent-led lead-reconciliation step per RFC-29 D2. `kind: request` is returned by `specrun plan propose --dry-run --format json`: a flat catalog of raw, unmerged `(source-key, lead-id)` leads read 1:1 from `discovery.md` plus locked/advisory reconciliation clusters, targets, and optional workspace projects. `kind: response` is the agent's grouping consumed by `specrun plan propose --from`: `concepts[]` partitions the surveyed leads exactly once, while `slices[]` references those concepts and binds each `(concept-id, target)` pair to one target and optional project. The kernel validates this shape, enforces the global partition and locked-cluster invariants, derives unique `plan.yaml.slices[]` names from optional `name` or concept/target fallback, and writes through the existing plan writers; it never auto-merges on its own heuristic — cross-source unification is the agent's grouping in the response. Closed top-level shape: unknown fields are rejected.

targetRef.description: Target adapter identifier, e.g. `omnia@v1` or `contracts@v1`. Mirrors `plan.schema.json` slice `target` pattern.

projectRef.description: One registered project from `registry.yaml`, surfaced into the request so the agent can bind each response slice to a project by matching the slice's concept and target against the project's `target` and `description`.

name.description: Registry project name; the value the kernel writes to `plan.yaml.slices[].project`.

target.description: The project's registered target adapter. A response slice may only bind to a project whose registered `target` equals the slice's `target`.

description.description: Single-sentence domain characterisation used by the agent when more than one project shares a target.

matchBasis.description: How a lead joined its final concept. `exact-id` / `exact-alias` are deterministic kernel-computed matches (the same `lead-id`, or an alias, surfaced across source keys); `semantic` is the agent's cross-source judgment and is surfaced for operator review.

lockedBasis.description: Kernel-computed proof basis for a locked cluster binding: an exact `lead-id` or exact alias match across source keys.

sharedFacet.description: Namespaced grouping facet, namespaced as `<kind>:<value>` (for example `domain:identity`, `module:auth`, `entity:user`, `route:/password/reset`, or lexical fallback `token:reset`). Survey metadata carries these on each lead as `blocking-keys[]`; cluster `shared-facets[]` is the union across member surfacings.

clusterBindingRef.description: Request-side binding of this catalog row to one reconciliation cluster. Unmatched rows omit `cluster-binding`.

cluster-id.description: Reconciliation cluster this catalog row is bound to.

basis.description: Kernel-computed proof for a locked cluster binding. Present only when `cluster-id` names a locked cluster; per-row, so one locked cluster may mix bases.

lead-id.description: Discovery lead id surfaced by this source binding. Identity is the `(source-key, lead-id)` pair; `lead-id` is not unique across `leads[]` when multiple sources surface the same id.

summary.description: One-line per-source summary from this source's survey of the lead.

aliases.description: Optional aliases from the surveyed Lead, used for exact-alias locked clusters and lexical fallback.

id.description: Stable id for a request-side reconciliation cluster. Response `concepts[].from-cluster-id` may cite advisory clusters for review traceability.

constraint.description: `locked` clusters are deterministic exact-id / exact-alias clusters the agent may extend but not split. `advisory` clusters are search-space hints that do not constrain response membership.

shared-facets.description: Union of grouping facets shared by this cluster's member surfacings. On advisory clusters, facets explain how the kernel bucketed open leads; on locked clusters, facets are annotative (union of member survey metadata). Lexical fallback facets use the `token:<term>` namespace.

adjacent-clusters.description: Locked cluster ids adjacent to this advisory cluster because an open lead shares a facet with a locked-cluster member. Invitation to consider extension, not a match decision.

projects.description: Registry topology in workspace mode: every entry from `registry.yaml#/projects[]` (name + target + description). Absent in single-repo mode.

clusters.description: Request-side reconciliation clusters computed by the kernel before agent grouping.

leads.description: Flat lead catalog: one row per raw `(source-key, lead-id)` lead, read 1:1 from `discovery.md` (no expansion or cross-source merge). Each row names at most one request-side cluster via optional `cluster-binding`; unmatched rows omit `cluster-binding`. The `lead-id` field repeats across rows when multiple sources surface the same discovery id.

source-key.description: Plan source binding key; must match a request catalog row.

lead-id.description: Discovery lead id; with `source-key`, must match a request catalog row.

tentative.description: Agent-flagged low-confidence membership; surfaced for operator review at Gate 1.

concept-id.description: Concept id for a unit of work. Response `slices[]` entries reference this id; it is not necessarily the derived plan slice name.

from-cluster-id.description: Optional id of the request advisory cluster that most directly explains this concept. Review traceability only; the kernel does not constrain membership by cluster.

rationale.description: Agent's reason for the concept membership; rendered into change.md for operator review, most useful on semantic merges.

concept-id.description: Concept id of a declared `concepts[]` entry. May repeat across response slices when the same concept fans out to multiple targets.

name.description: Optional explicit plan slice name for this `(concept-id, target)` row. When omitted, the kernel derives a unique slice name deterministically.

target.description: Exactly one target per response slice (one slice per `(concept-id, target)` pair, per D5). The same concept may appear under more than one target.

depends-on.description: Derived slice names this row depends on (not concept ids). Each name must resolve to a projected `plan.yaml.slices[]` entry.

project.description: Registry project this slice binds to, chosen by the agent from the request's `projects[]`. Required on every slice in workspace mode; omitted in single-repo mode.

rationale.description: Agent's reason for target or project binding when the choice is not obvious; rendered into change.md for operator review.
